## funanotation
```{bash}
# Run saccharomycesParadoxus2026

# Define reusable variables
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8

INPUT="outputs/medaka_output/medaka_round2/saccharomycesParadoxus2026/consensus.fasta"
SPECIES="Saccharomyces paradoxus"   
STRAIN="CP8-A_JSN"       

# Step 1: Clean redundant/short contigs ("genomic dust")
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate clean \
-i $INPUT \
-o data/S.paradoxus/assembly_clean.fasta

# Step 2: Sort contigs by length and standardize header names (scaffold_1, etc.)
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate sort \
-i data/S.paradoxus/assembly_clean.fasta \
-o data/S.paradoxus/assembly_sorted.fasta

# Step 3: Soft-mask repetitive elements
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate mask \
-i data/S.paradoxus/assembly_sorted.fasta \
-o data/S.paradoxus/assembly_masked.fasta \
--cpus $CPUS

# Step 4: Predict gene models using Saccharomycetes BUSCO models for training
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/data -w /data $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
funannotate predict \
-i data/S.paradoxus/assembly_masked.fasta \
-o outputs/funannotate_output/S.paradoxus \
-s "$SPECIES" \
--strain "$STRAIN" \
--busco_db dikarya \
--cpus $CPUS


# RUN saccharomycesBayanus2026
```
